_comment: DRIFTS voice phrases, spoken by the first model (Pi Zero + Whisplay HAT speaker) and Tokyo (Pi 5). The id is the clip number on both: never renumber, only add. Edit the text, then run: python Voice/make_clips.py

voice._license: Piper voice en_US-libritts_r-medium, trained on LibriTTS-R (CC BY 4.0)

phrases.name: LEVEL1
phrases.text: You seem tired. Consider taking a break soon.

phrases.name: LEVEL2
phrases.text: Warning. Signs of drowsiness detected. Please pull over when safe.

phrases.name: RECOVERED
phrases.text: Alertness back to normal. Thank you.

phrases.name: CHECK_IN
phrases.text: Are you okay? Press the button to confirm.

phrases.name: TEST
phrases.text: This is a DRIFTS voice test.

phrases.name: AWAKE
phrases.text: Are you awake? Please say: I am awake.

phrases.name: SHUTDOWN
phrases.text: DRIFTS is shutting down. Unplug when the screen goes dark.
